product_metadata.title: Vtopmart 4 Pieces Food Storage Containers 4.3L / 145.4oz, BPA Free Plastic Airtight Food Storage Containers for Flour, Sugar, Baking Supplies, with 4 Measuring Spoons and 24 Labels, Black
features: Make a Huge Difference in Pantry Organization ---- If you already got tired of messy flour and sugar bags, then don't hesitate to choose our food storage containers. These flour containers will make everything looks neat and in order. Come with 4 premium food storage canisters, 4 measuring spoons, 24 Labels, this container set will also be an ideal gift for any family.

Perfect for Storing Dry Food ---- The size of each container is 7.5 x 7.5 x 7.6 inch ( 4.3L / 145.4oz). These kitchen storage containers are perfect for many kinds of dry food and baking supplies, such as flour, sugar, rice, grain, chips, cereals, nuts, beans, snacks, pasta, coffee and tea. Plus wide enough openings to reach in with measuring spoons.

Made from High-Grade Plastic ---- These pantry storage containers are made from high-grade BPA free plastic, which has decent quality. Containers are fairly sturdy and nice looking, which are worth every cent you paid for them. The clear plastic let you see what is in the container, you can get what you want easily without opening every container.

Seal Securely ---- Vtopmart airtight food storage containers come with Side-locking lids that ensure maximum freshness and prolonged food storage by sealing tightly. They will protect your food from air and water, so you don't need to worry about your favorite foods turning stale anymore! Please ensure that the lid is lined up properly in order to close them.

Stackable Design ---- With the stackable design, these plastic storage containers will make more efficient use of every inch of your home kitchen. Whether you have a large or small pantry, these durable containers will help you organize your kitchen and pantry better. Easy to clean and dishwasher safe, please hand wash the lid.
description: Too often dry foods come in paper or plastic bags that, once you open them up, spill all over your kitchen cupboards or rice and grains on the pantry shelves. This is where Vtopmart food storage containers can come in clutch. They help organize the cupboards, save space, keep food fresh, and prevent food from spilling everywhere. Why choose our large food storage containers? It's simple really. Features * Dishwasher Safe, Freezer Safe, Microwave Safe (Remove Lid) * Stackable Design * Non-Slip & Sealing Lids * BPA Free * Reusable & Durable Package includes: 4 Durable Clear Storage Containers 4 Measuring Cups 24 FREE Reusable Chalkboard Labels
